description: Shared completed-list vectors. Each version is an immutable EntityVersion ProtoJSON value. Rows identify the existing selected projection and all unresolved heads; adapters preserve their own projection rules. Derive terminal entry from the full version graph, including parents outside a displayed history page. UNKNOWN is inclusive for duration selections. Requests are ListTasksRequest ProtoJSON. Evaluate completed and other filters before ordering and pagination. expected.pages splits the filtered order at page.size; cursor cases compare query, account and data-space scope, not an adapter cursor encoding.
